notes: Time ranges written in words now work. "Trim between 2 and 6 seconds" was fine, but "trim between two and six seconds" came back with nothing at all — Crisp read the second number and not the first, and then could not make sense of what was left. "Trim from two to six seconds" had the same gap. Spelled-out numbers that contain the word "and", like "one hundred and eighty degrees", keep working exactly as they did.
